sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS Proceeds received by the Trust from the issuance of Baskets consist of either INJ or cash. In addition, the Trust will receive proceeds from its staking program that consist of INJ. Deposits of INJ are held by the Custodian on behalf of the Trust (including for use in the Trust’s staking program) until (i) transferred out or sold in connection with redemptions of Baskets or (ii) transferred or sold by the Sponsor to pay fees due to the Sponsor or Trust expenses and liabilities not assumed by the Sponsor. Deposits of cash are held by the Cash Custodian on behalf of the Trust until (i) transferred in connection with the purchase of INJ, (ii) delivered out in connection with redemptions of Baskets or (iii) transferred to pay fees due to the Sponsor and Trust expenses and liabilities not assumed by the Sponsor.
